rationale.edition: Classified OSS. Every changed path (from the authoritative changed_files.txt) lives under tests/ui-testing/ — Playwright page objects (pages/dashboardPages/*.js), E2E specs (playwright-tests/Dashboards/*.spec.js), and ci-matrix config (ci-matrix/ci_matrix_cloud.json). None are under enterprise-owned directories, and there is no enterprise-gated product module. The diff body's LINKED/SISTER PR header combines the OSS test refactor with o2-enterprise #2497's ci_matrix_cloud.json addition, but both halves are test infrastructure for the OSS Dashboards feature (specs live in OSS per the pipeline convention), so edition is oss, not both.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. No explicit opt-out (no tests-added label, and feature_hint.txt / trigger_comment.txt are empty). The diff is test-only with no web/src, enterprise-web, or backend product change, but it modifies five files under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, so the dev-authored-tests rule applies: route to enhance and continue rather than auto-skip.
rationale.e2e: Warranted via the enhance route. The change hardens existing E2E coverage of user-facing dashboard flows — filter conditions/operators, general settings/tabs, joins, nested functions, and transpose: replacing waitForTimeout with deterministic waits (waitForDashboardContentLoaded, waitForQueryInspector, waitForVariablesPanel), adding cloud-auth/401-retry handling (getAuthHeaders, getOrgIdentifier, refreshCloudConfig), and strengthening query-inspector assertions. No new product flow, but the dev-authored specs exercise real UI behavior that needs preserving/validating.
rationale.area: Dashboards. All five changed specs live in tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/, and the five changed page objects are in tests/ui-testing/pages/dashboardPages/. Sibling specs for the same feature area sit in that same Dashboards folder.
rationale.group: Dashboards-Settings. The ci_matrix_cloud.json diff adds a new Dashboards-Settings testfolder shard (actual_folder Dashboards) that registers exactly these specs (dashboard-filter, dashboard-general-setting, dashboard-tabs-setting, dashboard-transpose, dashboard-join, dashboard-nested-functions, plus two more). The same Dashboards-Settings grouping already exists in ci_matrix_env.json and ci_matrix_firefox.json, so this is the closest existing matrix group.
rationale.existing_tests: Five Playwright E2E specs under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Dashboards/ are changed: dashboard-filter.spec.js, dashboard-general-setting.spec.js, dashboard-join.spec.js, dashboard-nested-functions.spec.js, and dashboard-transpose.spec.js. These are true E2E specs (not Vitest/Rust unit tests). They already cover the existing dashboard filter/settings/join/nested-functions/transpose features; the changes stabilize them rather than add new-behavior coverage, so the Architect should treat them as coverage to preserve and extend rather than replace.
